messages.content: Hi there! Thanks for taking the time to chat with me today. I’m looking to gather some information about the enhancements you’d like to see in the student portal. To start, could you please tell me what your high-level goals are for the new features, like personalised timetables, grade notifications, and module feedback?

Hey! Thanks for having me. So, I guess I just really want the portal to be easier to use. Like, the timetable is kind of a mess right now. It would be nice if I could make it look how I want, you know? Maybe colour-code stuff or hide the classes that are cancelled. 

And I really want to know when my grades are out without having to keep checking. Like, a little notification would be great. 

Oh, and giving feedback on my modules would be cool too. It just feels like there should be a way to do that.

That makes sense! So, you're looking for a more user-friendly experience with the ability to personalise your timetable, get notifications for your grades, and have a way to provide feedback on modules. 

For the personalised timetable, could you tell me a bit more about how you envision the colour-coding? What kind of options or features would you like to have?

Yeah, so for the colour-coding, I just think it would be helpful if I could pick different colours for each module. That way, I can easily see what I have on each day at a glance. Maybe even like a way to mark classes that I’m not going to, like when they get cancelled? Just something simple like that would make it so much easier to read.

Got it! So you’d like the option to pick different colours for each module to help you see your schedule at a glance. Also, marking cancelled classes would make it easier to read. 

Now, about the grade notifications, could you explain how you would like to receive those notifications? What kind of details would you want to be included?

I think just a quick notification when a new grade is posted would be enough. I don’t need anything too detailed, just something that says, like, “Hey, your grade for [module name] is in!” It would be nice to get it right away instead of waiting or having to check. Just a simple heads-up would be perfect!

That sounds great! So, you’d like a simple notification that alerts you when a new grade is posted, saying something like, “Hey, your grade for [module name] is in!” You want this to happen right away without having to check the portal constantly.

Now, for the module feedback system, could you share what kind of feedback you’d like to give? What would you want that process to look like?

Um, I guess I’d want to talk about how the module went, like if the content was good or if the teaching was helpful. It would be nice to have a way to say what worked and what didn’t, you know? 

I imagine it would be a simple form or something to fill out after the teaching is done. Just a chance to say what I liked or didn’t like about the module and maybe give some suggestions. It would feel good to have a way to share my thoughts!

That makes a lot of sense! So, for the module feedback system, you’d like a simple form to fill out after the teaching is done where you can share your thoughts on the module’s content, the teaching quality, and any suggestions for improvement. It sounds like a good way to express what worked and what didn’t.

Lastly, are there any limitations or restrictions we should keep in mind while working on these enhancements?

I haven’t really thought about any limitations or restrictions. I just want the portal to be easier to use and have these features. I guess it’s more about making sure it all works smoothly without making things worse. But I’m not really sure about any technical stuff or how that all works.

That's understandable! Your main focus is on making the portal easier to use with these new features and ensuring everything works smoothly without causing any issues. 

To summarize what we've discussed so far:
1. Personalised timetable with colour-coding for each module and the ability to mark cancelled classes.
2. Quick notifications for new grades, alerting you when they are posted.
3. A simple feedback form for modules to share your thoughts on content and teaching quality.

I think we have a good set of requirements here!
